column2: ENGLISH

The time has come! [From.GetSocietyRank] [From.GetFirstName] believes our organization has grown strong enough to no longer need to hide in the shadows. It is time to rise against the false gods and profess loyalty to [Root.GetTrueReligionHighGod], standing proud with my [Root.GetTrueReligionAdjective] brothers and sisters!
At last!

At long last, we reap the rewards of our hard work. Any fellow cultist of [Root.GetDWDevil] in our realm willing shall join me in this victory, as we sow [GetDWBrethrenType] in [Root.GetDWDevil]'s name!
A new era begins.

All your fellow followers of [Root.GetDWDevil], within your realm, will convert to the worship of [Root.GetDWDevil]. If you are a vassal, and your top liege isn't a member of the cult, you will rebel against them.\n

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has revealed a shocking truth. [From.GetSheHeCap] is a foul servant of [From.Religion.GetHighGodName], and [From.GetSheHe] is not alone among the nobility of our realm. For years they have been influencing the populace to worship their dark master, and there are even places in my own lands where most of the populace grovels before [From.Religion.GetHighGodName]!
How did they keep it secret for so long?

While [From.GetTitledFirstName] has always been a little strange, I never could have known that [From.GetSheHe] was secretly a servant of [From.Religion.GetHighGodName]! Along with a cabal of other nobles in my realm who have been harboring heretical beliefs for years, [From.GetSheHe] has now openly professed to what [From.GetSheHe] dares call 'the true faith.'
I cannot allow this heresy to stand...!

[Root.GetSocietyRank] [Root.GetFirstName],

Our cult is growing steadily in the shadows, but for our ultimate goal to rise against the followers of the false gods, we need to have the support of the local populace. You should spread our influence in the lands of [target_province.GetName].

[Root.GetDWExpression],
Signed, [From.GetSocietyRank] [From.GetFirstName]

While there are only a handful of them, there are a few people in [target_province.GetName] who have heard the call of [Root.GetDWDevil] are willing to attend our rituals. It will take a long time, but they will become true worshippers, and will be able to spread our grand message to ever more new cultists. One day we will rise against the followers of the false gods, in the name of [Root.GetDWDevil]!.
In due time these dark seeds will blossom.
Our agent will report back about the progress of our conversion.

With the passing of [target_province.GetName] from our realm, my brethren and I are finding it to be more challenging than ever to spread the influence of [Root.GetDWDevil] there.\nPeople seemed to be listening, but for now our efforts must be abandoned until we find a new opportunity.
We can no longer safely operate in that area.

Our effort to establish a cell of [Root.GetSocietyName] cultists in [target_province.GetName] has proven far easier than I thought. The populace revels in the [Root.GetDWBrethrenType] of [Root.GetDWDevil], and as the believers grow in number, so does our influence. We may have a self-sustaining cell of cultists sooner than we thought.
Glory to [Root.GetDWDevil]!

Our effort to establish a cell of cultists in [target_province.GetName] is going well. As the number of believers grows, so does our influence, and more people turn to the worship of [Root.GetDWDevil].
All shall be [Root.GetDWDevil]'s!.

Our effort to establish a cell of cultists in [target_province.GetName] is not working out. The acolytes I have given charge of the operation to are struggling to attract new worshippers, and without growth even some of our early converts are starting to harbor doubts.
I will provide all the support they require.
We should abandon our efforts in [target_province.GetName] for now.

After much work, dedication to [Root.GetDWDevil] and dark deeds, the cell of [Root.GetSocietyName] cultists in [target_province.GetName] has grown far larger than what it once was. Believers in great numbers revel in [Root.GetDWBrethrenType] while ensuring their worship stays hidden from the world. The cell has blossomed into a dark flower, and new brethren find the truth of [Root.GetDWDevil] by the day.
[Root.GetDWExpression]!

I'm having dinner and plenty of drinks with [chaos_cult_recruiter.GetTitledName] tonight. It's lovely, yet what I am most charmed by is [chaos_cult_recruiter.GetFirstName] [chaos_cult_recruiter.GetHerselfHimself]. Why else would I not immediately stop our conversation, which has slowly begun to touch upon some almost heretical ideas, questioning the might of [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName]?
Why does [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] ignore us ?
We should not speak of this, [chaos_cult_recruiter.GetFirstName].
You think it's a great discussion, fueled by alcohol or not.\n
You would never question the authority of the almighty.\n

Meeting with [chaos_cult_recruit.GetTitledFirstName], I made sure to only cautiously question the absolute power of [chaos_cult_recruit.GetHerHis] almighty [chaos_cult_recruit.Religion.GetHighGodName]... Thankfully, it seems that my carefully chosen words had the desired effect on [chaos_cult_recruit.GetHerHim]. From [chaos_cult_recruit.GetHerHis] glittering eyes I got the distinct impression that [chaos_cult_recruit.GetSheHe] enjoyed the philosophical aspect of our conversion.

Meeting with [chaos_cult_recruit.GetTitledFirstName], I made sure to only cautiously question the absolute power of [chaos_cult_recruit.GetHerHis] almighty [chaos_cult_recruit.Religion.GetHighGodName]... Regretfully, it seems that my words only irritated my [chaos_cult_recruit.GetRootRelation] – from the steely look [chaos_cult_recruit.GetSheHe] finally gave me, I should probably steer clear of [chaos_cult_recruit.GetHerHim] for now.
A sensible [chaos_cult_recruit.GetManWoman], [chaos_cult_recruit.GetFirstName].
I'm not sure [chaos_cult_recruit.GetHerHis] sentiments were sincere...
Disappointing.
Continue your endeavor to recruit §Y[From.GetTitledFirstName]§! to [Root.Society.GetName].\n
You end your endeavor to recruit §Y[From.GetTitledFirstName]§! to [Root.Society.GetName].\n

Walking the palisades of my [Root.GetCapitalHolding] I am joined by [chaos_cult_recruiter.GetTitledFirstName]. I find myself agreeing with a lot of the concepts [chaos_cult_recruiter.GetSheHe] presents – the futility of prayer particularly resonates with me. Suddenly, [chaos_cult_recruiter.GetSheHe] turns to me and presses a small leather pouch into my hand. "My [Root.GetLordLady], will you carry this with you, for protection?"
I'll keep it hidden, and I thank you, [chaos_cult_recruiter.GetFirstName].
What is this? I should call you a [chaos_cult_recruiter.GetDWMagician]!
You encourage the advances made by §Y[chaos_cult_recruiter.GetTitledFirstName]§!.\n
You distance yourself from §Y[chaos_cult_recruiter.GetTitledFirstName]§!.\n

I've arranged a run-in with [From.GetTitledFirstName] on the palisades of [From.GetHerHis] [From.GetCapitalHolding] today. [From.GetHerHisCap] face lights up upon seeing me and we stay out talking for hours. I offer [From.GetHerHim] a protection spell, in a leather pouch – of course, I do not explain the content... Yet [From.GetSheHe] smiles, accepting the token.

I've arranged a run-in with [From.GetTitledFirstName] on the palisades of [From.GetHerHis] [From.Capital.GetHolding] today. [From.GetHerHisCap] face darkens when I again attempt to discuss my world views. I then offer [From.GetHerHim] my favorite protection spell, a chicken leg in a leather pouch – I thought it was harmless enough, but [From.GetSheHe] refuses to accept the gift.
[From.GetSheHeCap] just needs one more little push.
It's been interesting, but I don't think [From.GetSheHe] is ready for more.
This has been a wasted effort – [From.GetFirstName] is locked in [From.GetHerHis] views.
Invite §Y[From.GetTitledFirstName]§! to [Root.Society.GetName].

What if I told you that all you have been taught to believe in is a lie? [chaos_cult_recruiter.GetFirstName] continues, throwing a cautious glance around us before pulling up [chaos_cult_recruiter.GetHerHis] sleeve, revealing a scar in the shape of [chaos_cult_recruiter.GetDWDevil]'s mark. "[Root.Religion.GetHighGodNameCap] is a lie, only the power of [chaos_cult_recruiter.GetDWDevil] is real..."
You truly are a [chaos_cult_recruiter.GetDWMagician] then? Can you [Root.GetDWReasonToJoin]?
That is blasphemy, [chaos_cult_recruiter.GetFirstName]! Leave my sight, before I call the guards!
You ask §Y[chaos_cult_recruiter.GetTitledFirstName]§! how you can begin your journey into this forbidden knowledge.\n
You dismiss §Y[chaos_cult_recruiter.GetTitledFirstName]'s§! offer and pretend it never happened.\n

When I revealed the brand on my lower arm, expecting the final hook to sink in, [From.GetFirstName] staggered backwards in shock and made a hand gesture for protection. "That is blasphemy, [Root.GetFirstName]" [From.GetSheHe] said, eyes wide. "Leave my sight, before I call the guards!" [From.GetSheHe] called and it was with reluctance, albeit hastily, that I left.
If I can't turn [From.GetHerHim], no one can.

When I proceeded to reveal the brand on my lower arm, certain that the final hook would sink in, [From.GetFirstName] inhaled sharply, worrying me for a second. "You truly are a [Root.GetDWMagician] then" [From.GetSheHe] says, eager and relieved. "Can you help me [From.GetDWReasonToJoin]?" [From.GetSheHe] continues, eyes pleading.
Patience, [From.GetSisterBrother]. We will speak more soon.
Write a letter to the coven about §Y[From.GetTitledFirstName]'s§! induction. [chaos_cult_inductor.GetSocietyRank] §Y[chaos_cult_inductor.GetFirstName]§! will handle it from here.

We might... If you offer yourself up to [chaos_cult_recruiter.GetDWDevil], the god will grant you powers [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] has kept from us humans. Fingering the leather pouch in my pocket, I slowly nod. "Oh, and I think you'll enjoy it..." [chaos_cult_recruiter.GetSheHe] said, with a knowing smile.
If there is any chance it'll [Root.GetDWReasonToJoin], I will.
§Y[chaos_cult_recruiter.GetTitledFirstName]§! leaves you alone for now – the coven will be in contact with you.\n

I am not sure what has happened, but it has been a while since I've had any contact with [chaos_cult_recruiter.GetBestName]. It's disappointing, as I was sort of curious to see where our meetings were going... As I retire tonight, I feel convinced that our time together has somehow ended prematurely.
Something must have gone wrong.
You will have to await a new recruiter from the clandestine society.

It has been some time since [chaos_cult_recruiter.GetTitledFirstName] was in contact with me. I have been pondering what [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] would think of me for venturing down this path, but [chaos_cult_recruiter.GetFirstName] has already offered me more support than [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] ever has. I have begun studying books on the Ruinous Powers and so far I'm finding the views preached at the [Root.GetHouseOfWorship] to be narrow-minded, at best.
Their lies are meant to hold us back!
You continue to await further instruction.\n

I found some cryptic scrawlings written in blood on my bedroom door this morning. The guards say they haven't seen anyone enter during the night and I dare not ask my [Root.GetLordSpiritualName] to decipher it. Yet, I think I understand... the mark of [chaos_cult_recruiter.GetDWDevil].
Of course, the bargain must be struck!
My immortal soul... What if I'm wrong?
You carve [chaos_cult_recruiter.GetDWDevil]'s mark into your arm, just like the one §Y[chaos_cult_recruiter.GetTitledFirstName]§! showed you.\n
You order your servants to scrub the door clean, putting to rest any rumors this could stir up.\n

[Root.GetSisterBrotherCap] [Root.GetFirstName],
We have received word of your dedication and desire to join in the worship of [From.GetDWDevil]. Await the messenger.

Let [From.GetDWDevil] guide you.
Signed, [From.GetSocietyRank] [From.GetFirstName]
Finally.
You will be on the look-out for "the messenger".\n

I've met an intriguing [From.GetManWoman] at court. Apparently, this [From.GetFirstName] is a foreign diplomat? I engaged [From.GetHerHim] in conversation for the first time today, and we spoke at length about [Root.GetEducationalTopicPlural]. I was shocked when [From.GetSheHe] carefully pulled up [From.GetHerHis] sleeve, revealing the mark of [From.GetDWDevil].

I've met an intriguing and hypnotically beautiful [From.GetManWoman] at court. Apparently, this [From.GetFirstName] is a foreign diplomat? I engaged [From.GetHerHim] in conversation for the first time today, and we spoke at length about [Root.GetEducationalTopicPlural]. I was shocked when [From.GetSheHe] carefully pulled up [From.GetHerHis] sleeve, revealing the mark of [From.GetDWDevil].
You're the messenger?

The [chaos_cult_inductor.GetSocietyRank] smiles. "I'm pleased to find you not only an affable [Root.GetManWoman], [Root.GetFirstName], but also one capable of intellectual discourse. The brethren value the pursuit of knowledge and power." [From.GetHerHisCap] smile turns into a grin as [From.GetSheHe] continues: "We'll soon see exactly how committed you are..."
I... What do you need me to do?
§Y[chaos_cult_inductor.GetTitledFirstName]§! offers no reply, instead guiding you to a dilapilated building...

[chaos_cult_inductor.GetFirstName] escorts me to the building. I hesitate upon entering, finding its walls splattered with blood and guts. Several hooded, bloodied figures surround the room, chanting in unison. "KILL FOR KHORNE! KILL FOR KHORNE!"... they want me to murder [khornate_sacrifice.GetBestName]!

[chaos_cult_inductor.GetFirstName] escorts me to the building. I hesitate upon entering, finding its walls splattered with blood and guts. Several hooded, bloodied figures surround the room, chanting in unison. "KILL FOR KHORNE! KILL FOR KHORNE!"... they want me to murder an innocent lowborn servant!

[chaos_cult_inductor.GetFirstName] escorts me to the building. I hesitate upon entering, a very foul smell coming from inside. Several hooded, dirty and sick-looking figures surround the room, chanting in unison: "Grandfather Nurgle loves us!". [chaos_cult_inductor.GetFirstName] presents me a chalice with a foul looking mixture filling it and says "Drink, drink from Grandfather Nurgle's sweet gifts!".

[chaos_cult_inductor.GetFirstName] escorts me to the building. I hesitate upon entering, the very air crackling with foul energies. Several hooded, deformed figures surround the room, chanting in unison: "Njawrr’thakh ’Lzimbarr Tzeentch!". [chaos_cult_inductor.GetFirstName] presents me a small glowing green stone and proclaims "Eat, eat and embrace Change!".

[chaos_cult_inductor.GetFirstName] escorts me to the building. I find myself eager to enter, the inside's sweet aromas and sights arousing my... every sense. Several hooded, voluptuous and statuesque figures surround the room, chanting in unison: "Pain is pleasure! Pleasure is pain!". [chaos_cult_inductor.GetFirstName] pushes me into a soft bed and whispers "Come, lets experience ultimate pleasure!".

[chaos_cult_inductor.GetFirstName] escorts me to the building. I hesitate upon entering, eldritch and blasphemous chants coming from inside. Several hooded figures surround the room, chanting in unison. "Chaos is the only true master!". They want me to murder [undivided_sacrifice.GetBestName], a holy priest of [undivided_sacrifice.Religion.GetHighGodName]!

[chaos_cult_inductor.GetFirstName] escorts me to the building. I hesitate upon entering, eldritch and blasphemous chants coming from inside. Several hooded figures surround the room, chanting in unison. "Chaos is the only true master!". They want me to murder a holy priest of [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName]!
I'll do whatever it takes
I... I can't do this!
I can't do this! I'm a married [Root.GetManWoman]!
Blood for the blood god...BLOOD FOR THE BLOOD GOD!\n
You drink from the foul chalice...\n
You eat the warpstone...\n
Ooooh...yes\n
Glory to Chaos!\n
You refuse this heretic ritual and try to escape!\n

I am not sure what has happened, but it has been a while since I've had any contact with [chaos_cult_inductor.GetBestName]. It's disappointing, as I was sort of curious to see where our meetings were going... As I retire tonight, I feel convinced that our time together has somehow ended prematurely.
Something must have gone wrong.
You will have to await a new recruiter from the clandestine society.

With the bloody ritual finished, [chaos_cult_inductor.GetFirstName] congratulates me. "Welcome to [chaos_cult_inductor.GetSocietyName], [Root.GetTitledFirstName]", [chaos_cult_inductor.GetSheHe] says, "You're now a servant of the Lord of Skulls".

With the foul ritual finished, [chaos_cult_inductor.GetFirstName] congratulates me. "Welcome to [chaos_cult_inductor.GetSocietyName], [Root.GetTitledFirstName]", [chaos_cult_inductor.GetSheHe] says, "You're now in Grandfather Nurgle's loving embrace".

With the eldritch ritual finished, [chaos_cult_inductor.GetFirstName] congratulates me. "Welcome to [chaos_cult_inductor.GetSocietyName], [Root.GetTitledFirstName]", [chaos_cult_inductor.GetSheHe] says, "You're now an asset of the Architect of Fate".

When I wake up the cloaked figures are gone and [chaos_cult_inductor.GetFirstName] is lying next to me, a smile tugging at the corner of [chaos_cult_inductor.GetHerHis] mouth. "Welcome to [chaos_cult_inductor.GetSocietyName], [Root.GetTitledFirstName]", [chaos_cult_inductor.GetSheHe] says, "You're now a servant of the Prince of Pleasure".

With the blasphemous ritual finished, [chaos_cult_inductor.GetFirstName] congratulates me. "Welcome to [chaos_cult_inductor.GetSocietyName], [Root.GetTitledFirstName]", [chaos_cult_inductor.GetSheHe] says, "You're now a servant of the Ruinous Powers".
I wish you had found me sooner.
[chaos_cult_inductor.GetDWExpression]

I let go of [chaos_cult_inductor.GetFirstName]'s hand and [chaos_cult_inductor.GetHerHis] smile vanishes. "What are you doing?", the beautiful creature asks. "I'm sorry, [chaos_cult_inductor.GetFirstName]. This is not my path." [chaos_cult_inductor.GetSheHeCap] takes my hand again, but only kisses it gently before turning away. "Only the [chaos_cult_inductor.GetDWDevil] knows. I will remember you, [Root.GetFirstName]." [chaos_cult_inductor.GetSheHeCap] hesitates, before adding: "I think you're special."

My eyes dart wildly around the ungodly scene. The [chaos_cult_inductor.GetSocietyRank] [chaos_cult_inductor.GetFirstName] looks disappointed. My body finally unfreezes and I bolt for the door. "Brothers and sisters, follow [Root.GetHerHim]! [Root.GetFirstName], we can talk about this!" The voice echoes behind me, as I run away. What was I thinking, getting involved in the [Root.GetDWDarkMagic]?! As I flee, panic in my chest, I trip.

My eyes dart wildly around the ungodly scene. The evil [chaos_cult_inductor.GetSeductressSeducer] rolls [chaos_cult_inductor.GetHerHis] eyes as I bolt for the door. "Brothers and sisters, see to it that [Root.GetSheHe] doesn't do anything stupid." I don't make it far before I stumble and fall to the floor, a spear sticking out of my chest.
[Root.Religion.GetHighGodNameCap] may punish me for it, but I'll remember you, too.
Guards! GUAAARDS!!!
This is... not... good.
With some help from some of your most loyal guards §Y[chaos_cult_inductor.Society.GetName]§! are discretely escorted away from your [Root.GetCapitalHolding]. "Lost travelers", you explain.\n
[chaos_cult_inductor.Society.GetNameCap] escape from your [Root.GetCapitalHolding].\nYou are injured during the chaos.\n
[chaos_cult_inductor.Society.GetNameCap] escape from your [Root.GetCapitalHolding] and you are tragically killed during the chaos.\n

[chaos_cult_inductor.Society.GetNameCap] might not be as bad as I thought, I muse to myself. I sometimes wonder what would have happened had I decided to join them. And I wonder where that beautiful creature went off to. Some ungodly adventure, surely.
My time is better spent far away from them.
§Y[Root.GetTitledFirstName]§! will never worship [Root.GetDWDevil].\n

[Root.GetDWDevil] has seen your good work, [Root.GetSocietyRank] [Root.GetFirstName].
The recruit you sent us, [chaos_cult_recruit.GetTitledFirstName], has now completed [chaos_cult_recruit.GetHerHis] induction into the coven. I thank you for this contribution – it will not be forgotten.

Signed, Grand Master [From.GetFirstName]

[Root.GetDWDevil] knows what has happened, [Root.GetSocietyRank] [Root.GetFirstName]
The recruit you sent us, [chaos_cult_recruit.GetTitledFirstName], has proven a disaster. We have spent significant resources in our attempt to induct [chaos_cult_recruit.GetHerHim], all for naught. This lack of judgment will be remembered.

Signed, Grand Master [From.GetFirstName]

[Root.GetDWDevil] has seen your good work, [Root.GetSocietyRank] [Root.GetFirstName].
The recruit you sent us, [chaos_cult_recruit.GetTitledFirstName], has now completed [chaos_cult_recruit.GetHerHis] induction into the coven. With so many of us already preaching the word, we have decided [chaos_cult_recruit.GetSheHe] would serve best by keeping quiet and waiting for the day we summon our brethren to arms, so as not to draw attention to ourselves. I thank you for this contribution – it will not be forgotten.

Signed, Grand Master [From.GetFirstName]

[Root.GetSisterBrotherCap] [Root.GetFirstName],

The one who was to guide you to us has gone to [From.GetDWDevil] before the rite could be finished. Your devotion has not gone unnoticed. If you still wish it, our doors are open to you: come to us, take the mark, and be one of us.

Signed, [From.GetSocietyRank] [From.GetFirstName]

[Root.GetFirstName],

Our agent did not live to finish what was started with you. That changes nothing. We have watched you, and we know what you are capable of. Say the word and you will be one of us. Refuse, and we will not ask again.

Signed, [From.GetSocietyRank] [From.GetFirstName]
I accept. [Root.GetDWExpression]
I have changed my mind.
Though my last act of worship has been some time ago, I can still sense an inhuman touch upon my soul whenever I think about what I did. I have become a changed [Root.GetManWoman].
A tainted soul is but a small price to pay...

[Root.GetDWDevil]'s favors, [Root.GetSocietyRank] [Root.GetFirstName],

We believe it would please [Root.GetDWDevil] greatly should [corrupt_priest_mission_target.GetTitledFirstName] fall into depravity. See to it, and you will be greatly rewarded.

[Root.GetDWExpression]
Signed, [From.GetSocietyRank] [From.GetFirstName]

No person lives a life entirely devoid of sin, and neither does [corrupt_priest_target.GetTitledFirstName]. I just have to find some traits of [corrupt_priest_target.GetHerHis] character that I can build on...
I'll turn [corrupt_priest_target.GetHerHis] guilty pleasures into vices!
I'm sure [corrupt_priest_target.GetSheHe]'s not quite as virtuous as [corrupt_priest_target.GetSheHe] pretends to be!
No, I don't think this is productive.
Send people to find out whether §Y[corrupt_priest_target.GetTitledFirstName]§! has any character traits that could develop into vices.\n
Send people to find out whether §Y[corrupt_priest_target.GetTitledFirstName]§! has any virtues [corrupt_priest_target.GetSheHe] might not whole-heartedly believe in.\n
Give up your attempt at corrupting §Y[corrupt_priest_target.GetTitledFirstName]§!.\n

My agents have proved their worth! It would appear that [corrupt_priest_target.GetTitledFirstName] has a liking for the pleasures of the flesh. A night of debauchery could well turn [corrupt_priest_target.GetHerHis] secret liking into a publicly-known love. I shall write the invitation...

My agents have uncovered rumors that [corrupt_priest_target.GetTitledFirstName] rather enjoys [corrupt_priest_target.GetHerHis] feasts. Introducing [corrupt_priest_target.GetHerHim] to new, exotic flavors might fuel [corrupt_priest_target.GetHerHis] appetite even further. I shall write the invitation...

Thorough investigation has revealed [corrupt_priest_target.GetTitledFirstName] rather likes [corrupt_priest_target.GetHerHis] gold. I wonder if [corrupt_priest_target.GetSheHe] is a gambling [corrupt_priest_target.GetManWoman]? I shall write the invitation...

It would seem that [corrupt_priest_target.GetTitledFirstName] is somewhat bothered by the hassles of ruling. I could show [corrupt_priest_target.GetHerHim] how much more enjoyable it is to do nothing, instead. I shall write the invitation...

[corrupt_priest_target.GetTitledFirstName] apparently has problems coming to terms with [corrupt_priest_target.GetHerHim] not having what [corrupt_priest_target.GetHerHis] neighbor has. Perhaps I can convince [corrupt_priest_target.GetHerHim] of how right [corrupt_priest_target.GetHerHis] feelings are over a banquet. I shall write the invitation...

My agents met with several of [corrupt_priest_target.GetTitledFirstName]'s courtiers, who all spoke of barely-suppressed outbursts of anger on the part of their [corrupt_priest_target.GetLordLady]. I should speak with [corrupt_priest_target.GetFirstName] and convince [corrupt_priest_target.GetHerHim] to henceforth let it all out, instead. I shall write the invitation...

[corrupt_priest_target.GetTitledFirstName] seems to quite enjoy flattery and praise. I could organize a celebration in [corrupt_priest_target.GetHerHis] honor, affirming [corrupt_priest_target.GetSheHe] has reason to be haughty. I shall write the invitation...

[corrupt_priest_target.GetTitledFirstName]'s court appears to be in a mild state of confusion. [corrupt_priest_target.GetFirstName] seems to have a penchant for telling minor lies and watching the confusion that ensues. I should invite [corrupt_priest_target.GetHerHim] and show [corrupt_priest_target.GetHerHim] how much more rewarding the bigger lies are. I shall write the invitation...

My agents have revealed that [corrupt_priest_target.GetTitledFirstName] is not always equally just in [corrupt_priest_target.GetHerHis] judgments. If [corrupt_priest_target.GetSheHe] were to visit and judge some of my criminals, I could encourage [corrupt_priest_target.GetHerHim] to judge based on appearance and whim. I shall write the invitation...

[corrupt_priest_target.GetTitledFirstName]'s courtiers have learned not to walk too closely by [corrupt_priest_target.GetHerHim] at the top of the staircase. [corrupt_priest_target.GetSheHeCap] seems to quite enjoy them getting hurt. I'm sure [corrupt_priest_target.GetSheHe] would like to see my torture chamber! I shall write the invitation...
...and hope my ploy succeeds.
...and beseech [corrupt_priest_spell_caster.GetDWDevil] to empower me!
...and coat my words in honey.
...and use my knowledge of [corrupt_priest_spell_caster.Religion.GetScriptureName] to convince [corrupt_priest_target.GetHerHim].
Attempt to corrupt §Y[corrupt_priest_target.GetTitledFirstName]§!.\n

Making our way through the temple I and my companions enter the inner sanctum with its relics and religious idols. A small treasure in both the spiritual and material worlds lies before us. Such a rich and holy place will be most fitting for our dark deeds.

I will take the most expensive relics for myself!

These relics shall be put to better use. My use.
Desecrate them all in the name of [Root.GetDWDevil]!

[Root.GetDWExpression] My faithful and I exit the temple of [dw_desecration_target.GetName] having consecrated the place to Khorne, building a totem of skulls seared in blood. This action will surely attract a local enraged Beastman tribe to [dw_desecration_target.GetName].

[Root.Religion.GetRandomGodNameCap] save us from these plagues!

[Root.Religion.GetRandomGodNameCap] protect us from the gaze of the Dark Gods!

But... they'll still pay taxes, right?

My [From.GetSisterBrother] in [Root.GetDWBrethrenType], [From.GetBestNameWithoutRegnalNumber], was passing by and decided to pay me a surprise visit! [From.GetSubjectPronounCap] is in a lewd mood and thought we might stage an impromptu orgy in honor of [Root.Religion.GetRandomEvilGodName].

My [GetFromRelation] and [From.GetSisterBrother] in [Root.GetDWBrethrenType], [From.GetFirstName], is feeling lascivious and just suggested that we might stage an impromptu orgy together – in honor of the Dark Prince, of course!

No way! [From.GetPossPronounCap] debaucheries never end well...
Demonic orgies can be rewarding, but remember that [Root.Religion.GetRandomEvilGodName] is a cruel master...

Where am I?! Oh yes... the orgy – three days of wicked debaucheries conducted by a hunchbacked master of revels with a daemon's smile. The drugs, the copulation, the daemonette with the hypnotic flute... the ritual murder. Was it real? All I know is that [From.GetFirstName] sure knows how to throw a party!

Having indulged in at least four different kinds of exotic drugs, the last three days are a fiery haze in my mind. There was a woman with a forked tongue, a one-eyed dwarf and many other wonderful freaks – some of them might even have been real! Mmmm, and the tricks [From.GetFirstName] and I taught each other!

My memories of the last few days are dreamlike. There was lots of smoke, a cackling old crone and a nubile young woman with a long tail that could do all kinds of things... Oh, and there was a loud little master of revels ordering me and [From.GetFirstName] into various interesting positions. I never realized I liked [From.GetMenWomen] that way...
But most of all, my compliments to the chef!
I feel great!
I feel drained.
I feel like a changed [Root.GetManWoman]...
Let's do it again sometime.

After a lengthy discussion about the logistics of an upcoming ritual, my [From.GetSisterBrother] in [Root.GetDWBrethrenType], [From.GetBestNameWithoutRegnalNumber] stood up abruptly, a depraved grin splitting [From.GetPossPronoun] face: 'Well, I'm bored. I don't want to risk riling up the rabble.
Demonic outings can be rewarding, but remember that [Root.Religion.GetRandomEvilGodName] is a cruel master...

Wearing nondescript common clothes, [From.GetFirstName] and I are slowly making our way to town in amicable silence. [From.GetFirstName] and I are riding down to the camp at a lazy trot. As we pass by some children playing in front of an impressive yurt I am suddenly overcome with hatred and revulsion. This family is clearly favored by [Root.Religion.GetRandomGodName]...
Keep going. They get to live... for now.
[From.GetFirstName]... it's time to do [Root.Religion.GetRandomEvilGodName]'s work!
You picked the wrong neighbor, my friends...

The father of the family died last. Ah, but the marvels he got to see first! [FromFrom.GetFirstName] carved the wife's face off and pranced around wearing it as a mask, taunting and kissing the man while I boiled baby fat to make a flying potion. Finally, we constructed an idol of [Root.GetDWRandomDemon] from the dismembered bodies.

The father broke free just as we were putting out the eyes of the oldest girl. Somehow, the man got hold of a huge pestle and managed to brain [FromFrom.GetFirstName] before I could cut him down! [Root.Religion.GetRandomEvilGodName] must have been displeased with [FromFrom.GetFirstName], but I honored [FromFrom.GetObjectPronoun] by using parts of [FromFrom.GetObjectPronoun] for the idol of [Root.GetDWRandomDemon] I built with the bodies...

As soon as the first bellows start issuing forth from the bull, I order the human candles lit. I close my eyes and hum along with the infernal choir, my nightmares conquered once and for all...
These are the pleasures that await us all in the Realm of Chaos!

As [From.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal] and I were making our way down to the [Root.GetDWSettlement] along a darkened trail, someone suddenly threw a sack over me and I was mercilessly pummeled until I lost consciousness. Hooded characters forced me inside, with my mouth near a funnel of some kind. The hatch closed and soon I could hear demented music and chanting as the bull started to heat up. Please, [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName], forgive me. Save my soul!
AAARRGH! AAAAH!

As [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal] and I were making our way down to the [Root.GetDWSettlement] along a darkened trail, someone threw a sack over me and knocked me about a bit. Believing me to be inside, the [GetRootFromFromInsult] ordered the flames lit. With the bull heating up, oil was poured over a bunch of crucified prisoners and set on fire – human candles screaming in accompaniment to the bellows issuing forth from the bull. The fool never realized [FromFrom.GetSubjectPronoun] was cooking [FromFrom.GetPossPronoun] own [GetFromFromVsFromRelation], [From.GetFirstName]!
Hail [Root.GetDWRandomDemon]!

Good thing I wasn't actually in that bull... but, have you seen your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] lately? – Your old friend, [FromFromFrom.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal].'
[FromFromFrom.GetFirstName]!!!

Someone is picking me up. I don't know this strange lady, and where is she taking me..?
...but he stumbles and falls, blow dart in his neck!

The guards stopped the lady and brought me back.

Idiots!
There is no point trying to abduct [FromFromFrom.GetTitledFirstName] anymore, considering [FromFromFrom.GetSubjectPronoun] is dead!
Annoying!
[FromFromFrom.GetTitledFirstName] has ended up in prison, so there is no point trying to abduct [FromFromFrom.GetObjectPronoun] anymore.
Very well...

No, I'll just have to be patient.
